verdicts.tldr: the frameless path go-panics with m.Exception still set, so a gno repl session fails every later deferred call with the old panic
verdicts.details: machine.go:3275 sets m.Exception and 3285 panics UnhandledPanicError; RunStatements recovers at repl.go:137 and keeps r.m with the exception set. After `a := ""` and `b := a[0]`, `println(k())` with a deferred println prints d and then the old index error, `d := 1/z` reports the index error chained ahead of the division, and `x := recover()` hits a host nil deref at machine.go:3309 because Recover passes its m.Exception == nil guard with no containing frame. At the merge base the nil deref on fr.LastException fired before the assignment, so m.Exception stayed nil and the same session printed d and 4, with the wrong message for b := a[0]. The function-level path (doOpPanic2) already leaves m.Exception set at both versions (viafunc chains `first` into the later division error), so the REPL reuse was fragile before; the diff adds the package-level path. Keeper machines are Released, machine.go:272 `*m = Machine{`, so no node path sees the leftover. Fix run: `r.m.Exception = nil` in the RunStatements recover gives d then 4, a bare division error in both sequences, and go test ./gnovm/pkg/repl ok.
